newsitem.title: UK: Dollar orbits 1.79 marks ahead of German statement.
newsitem.headline: Dollar orbits 1.79 marks ahead of German statement.

text.p: The dollar firmed above overnight lows against the mark, retesting territory around 1.79 but caution ahead of an expected German cabinet statement on the mark today kept morning gains limited.
The dollar was knocked lower overnight when German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said late Tuesday the German cabinet would make a statement calling for a strong mark and euro after its meeting today.
Waigel's comments came soon after Bundesbank member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said the central bank backed the government's call for a strong mark.
